description: This source file defines the ModuleFactory class, which manages the lifecycle of modules in the OpenMRS platform, including loading, starting, stopping, unloading, updating modules, managing dependencies, extensions, privileges, and classloaders.

classes.name: ModuleFactory
classes.description: A class providing static methods for managing the lifecycle, dependencies, extensions, classloaders, and privileges of modules within the OpenMRS platform. Responsible for loading, starting, stopping, updating, and unloading modules, as well as handling module dependencies and extension points.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Loads a module from a given file or Module object, with an option to replace existing modules of the same ID and version.

methods.name: loadModules
methods.description: Loads multiple modules from the modules directory or a specified list of files.

methods.name: startModule
methods.description: Starts a specified module, executing activator methods and initializing its extensions and SQL updates.

methods.name: stopModule
methods.description: Stops a specified module, removing extensions, advising, and performing cleanup.

methods.name: unloadModule
methods.description: Unloads a module, removing it from loaded modules, classloader, and deleting its files.

methods.name: updateModule
methods.description: Updates a module by downloading a new version, unloading the old, and loading the new.

methods.name: getModuleById
methods.description: Returns a module by its module ID.

methods.name: getStartedModuleById
methods.description: Returns a started module by its module ID.

methods.name: getModuleByPackage
methods.description: Retrieves a loaded module by its package name.
